newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to consolidate, dip to 102.68.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to consolidate, dip to 102.68.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFEE will consolidate before making further gains, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"We expect Bunds to retrace a little further to the important breakout level at 102.60," said Bob Emanuels, vice president at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam.
"But we do not expect them to go that far today."
Emanuels said there was strong support from an uptrending channel at the 102.68 area.
The Bund future was trading at 102.78 at 0650 GMT, down 0.04 on the day.
The contract reached a high of 102.93 on Monday.
Trendline resistance kicks in at 103.08, with additional trend and Elliott wave resistance at 103.20, said Hans Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase in London.
"A setback from here is likely, but it has to decline below 102.78 to take it back into the 102.58/38 range," he said in a research note.
Stephen Hutt, technical analyst at NatWest Financial Futures in London, said hourly charts were bearish near-term.
"There is a dark cloud cover on candlestick charts and a bearish cross signal from the slow stochastics."
Major support for the contract lies at 102.61/59, Hutt said, with 102.38 and 102.30 below there.
Beyond this session, the contract has scope for further gains, analysts said.
"We remain very bullish on the medium term outlook. Any dips are a buying opportunity," said Emanuels.
Hutt found resistance up to the contract high at the 102.88/93 area, and a further barrier at 103.20.
"That equates to the 5.5 percent yield on the 10-year bond."
December Euromarks were trading at 96.78 at 0725 GMT, one basis point below Monday's settlement price.
